pathAssistantSteps.info:
Opportunity is booked and won. Handover to Implementation and CARE teams.

  • Confirm all cases are closed
  • Initiate implementation handover
  • Update CRM with final deal value and booking reference

Deal is confirmed. Booking Verification checklist must be completed before the opportunity can be booked or closed.

  • Complete Booking Verification checklist items
  • Ensure all document checklists are in Final status
  • Open B2B/Implementation case if applicable

Opportunity is closed and won. Confirm all post-close steps are complete.

  • Confirm all cases are closed
  • Verify final booking reference is recorded

Opportunity is lost. Document the loss reason and close any open support cases.

  • Close all open Cases linked to this Opportunity
  • Record the loss reason accurately for forecasting

Commercial terms are being negotiated with the customer. Ensure all deal approvals are in flight.

  • Confirm legal and commercial approvals are underway
  • Keep Deal Desk updated on any changes to commercial terms
  • Do not progress until all Pending Approval cases are resolved

Opportunity is being qualified. Confirm customer fit, IRM product alignment, and deal size to determine Touch Level.

  • Complete all qualification fields — Touch Level classification runs on save
  • Confirm Large Deal flag if applicable
  • Engage Deal Desk for High Touch opportunities

Solution design and proposal development. Work with Core Group Specialists to complete required support cases and document checklists.

  • Ensure all required support cases are open and assigned
  • Track document checklist completion — all must reach Final before progressing
  • Co-ordinate with Legal, Pricing, and InfoSec teams as needed
